answer_1.quote: To validate the effectiveness of PiFi on NLG tasks, we employed encoder-decoder models such as T5 base and BART base. These models were evaluated on a machine translation task with the Multi30k dataset and a text summarization task with the CNN/DailyMail dataset...

answer_2.quote: For both tasks, we used BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore, and BARTScore as a metric for measuring the performance of each model.
